International Vaccine Institute (IVI), republic of Korea. 12/10/2016 – 26/10/2016. Topic covered: Risk definition, Risk management process, Benefit of risk management in a project and risk management case studies.   -­‐ Vaccinology, International Vaccine Institute (IVI), Seoul, Korea, September 26-30, 2016.
